newsitem.title: USA: Blue Chip Value rights offering cleared.
newsitem.headline: Blue Chip Value rights offering cleared.

text.p: Blue Chip Value Fund Inc said its directors approved plans to proceed with a rights offering to existing stockholders.
The fund said it plans to issue one right to purchase an additional share of the fund for each five shares owned at a price of 95 percent of the lesser of net asset value, or market price.
The rights will not be transferable. Stockholders will also have the option to subscribe for additional shares during the offering, Blue Chip said.
It is expected that the rights will be issued to stockholders of record January 31, it said, adding the subscription period will begin February 3, and extend through 1700 EST/2200 GMT March 6.
The price of shares to be issued will be determined as of March 7, Blue Chip said. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
